title: Hackers Exploit CVE-2023-49105 to Steal Nuclear Records From Philippine Research Agency
content_md: Suspected Chinese-speaking operators exploited the critical ownCloud flaw CVE-2023-49105 to steal nuclear material records, research reactor data, personnel files, and encryption key material from a Philippine nuclear research organization. Hunt.io discovered an exposed file directory on August 13, 2026, hosted at 31.58.209[.]241:8000, an Amsterdam-based server registered to CGI Global Limited.
